paragraphs: R' Yannai (bar), son of R' Yannai the Elder.
Mentioned in Megillah 32a, reporting in the name of R' Yannai Rabbah.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied parenthetical (בר) stays before son-of, without deciding whether it is a variant, insertion or name component. The earlier provisional heading status remains. Elder translates סבא; Rabbah remains a different epithet, without harmonizing the two.

לב. gives Megillah 32a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification. The reporting relation remains Hyman’s statement, and all three personal title abbreviations remain R'.
